author: ThatWay
body:
Hi, my IGN is Lakso1234. I know I have hacked on this server twice, but now I have changed my mind. I stopped hacking ever since I started playing Hypixel now.  Since I have a rank on that server, I know that it would be a waste of money if I get banned.  So now, I am a legit player.  You guys can spectate me or do anything to see if I am hacking. To know that I am not hacking, you can just look at my Optifine cape. I am aware that some hack clients have optifine installed within them, but if people think I am hacking, then I will show you guys that I am not.  Tbh, I am also aware that you can turn off hacks too, but I will also prove to you guys that  I am still not hacking. Sorry if I didn't folow the rules back then. Please consider this. Thank You
-Lakso1234
